chunks: My father (rah) said: It was narrated to us by Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sa'dabadi from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi from Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sayrafi from Hammad ibn Isa from Ja'far from his father (a.s.) who said:
I like that there be a Mushaf (copy of the Quran) in the house, by which Allah drives away Satan.

key_terms.مُصْحَفٌ: A physical copy of the Quran

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of keeping the Quran at home according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-Amal*, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) highlights the spiritual efficacy of displaying the Quran in the home as a means of repelling Satan. This practice underscores the Quran's role not merely as a text for recitation, but as a physical presence that sanctifies the domestic space and protects the inhabitants from evil influences.
